Armor Thresholds
Grade: Delicate (Cloth Robe and Cloak, all paths). Bonus: +1 spell potency in full arcane robes; +2 with no armor at all; +2 and +2 to spell potency and Traveler Talents if a Dragonsilk Robe and Cloak is worn.

Paths and Branches unlock various Armaments not available for Class Tier Abilities.

A Path or Branch's Weapon Requirements include every weapon already available to the Main Class, plus any new weapons that Path or Branch unlocks. A Path or Branch's Armor Threshold also rises without an Armament Penalty, typically half a Grade step above the Tier before it.

Armament Thresholds allow the given Grade and anything lighter. If Armor that is heavier than the Sorcerer's Threshold is worn, Characters suffer the ensuing Penalties to the Armor's Score (see Armament Penalty, Basic Rules pg. 6).

Strategist (Playable in Starter Set)

Alignment: All

Calculating predators who win before the first blow lands, Strategists use intelligence, positioning, and layered deception to dismantle opponents from angles they never considered, equally dangerous in the shadows, in plain sight, or threading a spelled blade through a gap in armor that nobody else saw was there.

‡ Abilities from their respective trees are summarized below. Ability Cards are released with Module and their expansions, supporting various Character Levels, and list the DIFS for any check an Ability requires. Refer pg. 6 for more on Ability Cards.

Note: Main Class baseline stats, Armament requirements and thresholds, and other Class features change depending on the Classes Tier, Path or Branch as noted in each respective Sub-Class.

Favored Races:
Bast +5, Drow +5, Dwarf (Glimmerstone) +5, Helf +5, Goblorc +5, Halfling† +5, Miceling +5

†Halfling Playable with Starter Set.

Averse Races: Skrath -5

Refer to Races for details on favored and averse paths and branches.

Passive Abilities:
These passive Abilities belong to the Main Class alone, granted once and active regardless of Tier, Path, or Branch; they are not re-granted, replaced, or duplicated at any Path or Branch.

Tactical Precision, lasts 6 hours (must be recast every 6 hours to stay active). No mana cost for Main Class Abilities.

Killing Edge, Once Per Day the Strategist strikes from an unseen angle, dealing damage equal to twice their Deceit Score to one target, with the attack always counting as a Critical Hit.

Extra 1d6 + lvl shadow damage on Critical Hits.
Once per encounter, Strategists can Flourish their blade that lowers their target's Vigilance at a number equal to their Deceit Score.

Strategists get +5 feet their base movement speed, once per encounter.

Strategists get +4 plus their DECEIT Score on Stealth checks.

Favorite Talent and Profession Trees
Talent Trees: Thief
Professions: Gem Crafter, Tech Salvager, Data Broker

No Cost to open talent tree. 5% rate increase on profession tiers. See Talent and Profession Bonuses: Races vs. Classes for how these bonuses work.

Features such as; Companion Pairing, buffs, and various Armaments and Accessories and their Modifiers and Enhancements modify base stats, refer to Basic Rules for more.

Armor Thresholds
Grade: Light (Leather, Studded Leather). Bonus: +1 Defense and +1 Stealth in leather or lighter; +2 and +2 to Defense and Thief Talents if Leather is worn.

+1 Defense and +2 to Thief Talents if wearing Light or Delicate (Studded Leather).

Paths and Branches unlock various Armaments not available for Class Tier Abilities.

A Path or Branch's Weapon Requirements include every weapon already available to the Main Class, plus any new weapons that Path or Branch unlocks. A Path or Branch's Armor Threshold also rises without an Armament Penalty, typically half a Grade step above the Tier before it.

Armament Thresholds allow the given Grade and anything lighter. If Armor that is heavier than the Strategist's Threshold is worn, Characters suffer the ensuing Penalties to the Armor's Score (see Armament Penalty, Basic Rules pg. 6).

Tyrant (Not Playable in Starter Set)

Alignment Restrictions: Evil

Agents of pure destruction who revel in combat for its own sake, Tyrants channel rage, dominance, and shock-and-awe into relentless offensive pressure, whether through twin weapons blurring faster than defense can respond, a two-handed weapon that turns armor into scrap, or a voice alone that breaks enemy formations before a single blade is drawn.

‡ Abilities from their respective trees are summarized below. Ability Cards are released with Module and their expansions, supporting various Character Levels, and list the DIFS for any check an Ability requires. Refer pg. 6 for more on Ability Cards.

Note: Main Class baseline stats, Armament requirements and thresholds, and other Class features change depending on the Classes Tier, Path or Branch as noted in each respective Sub-Class.

Favored Races:
Troll (Common) +5, Gnoll +5, Human† +5, Orcus +5, Omnè +5

†Human Playable with Starter Set.

Averse Races: Firbolg -5, Elf (High) -5, Helf -5, Brownling -5, Gnome -5, Drevane -5

Refer to Races for details on favored and averse paths and branches.

Passive Abilities:
These passive Abilities belong to the Main Class alone, granted once and active regardless of Tier, Path, or Branch; they are not re-granted, replaced, or duplicated at any Path or Branch.

Warlord's Dominance, lasts 6 hours (must be recast every 6 hours to stay active). No mana cost for Main Class Abilities.

Reign of Ruin, Once Per Day the Tyrant unleashes overwhelming force, dealing physical damage equal to twice their Strength Score to one target and knocking them prone.

Extra 1d6 + lvl physical damage on Critical Hits.
Once per encounter, Tyrants can Flourish their weapon that lowers their target's Defense at a number equal to their Strength Score.

Tyrants get +5 feet their base movement speed, once per encounter.

Tyrants get +4 plus their STRENGTH Score on Intimidation checks.

Favorite Talent and Profession Trees
Talent Trees: Bounty Hunter
Professions: Hunter, Blacksmith, Body Artist

No Cost to open talent tree. 5% rate increase on profession tiers. See Talent and Profession Bonuses: Races vs. Classes for how these bonuses work.

Features such as; Companion Pairing, buffs, and various Armaments and Accessories and their Modifiers and Enhancements modify base stats, refer to Basic Rules for more.

Tyrant Tier Armaments
▸ Select to Expand Armaments Weapon Requirements (Must be readied and drawn to perform Abilities)

Weapon Styles and Hand:
◆1h dual-wielded or 2h, any Style (path dependent).

Weapon Types:
◆Martial Melee or Magic Melee for Nature or Spell Abilities respectively; may use TAW or Energy.
◆Restricted to Martial for Melee; wherever a Path or Branch may allow it.

Whenever Warlord's Dominance (see Main Class Abilities above) is Active:

◆Weapon Bonus†: Crit add 1d6 + STR.
◆1H Melee: +2 Hit (dual wield).
◆+2 and +2 to Hit and Bounty Hunter Talents if the Twin Fangs of Ruin are wielded.
◆a second 1h Weapon (Off) +2 Hit (dual wield, default), or an empty hand (Off) +1 Hit, +1 Defense instead (guarded stance).
◆2H Melee: +2 Hit, +1 Damage (Demolisher).
◆+2 and +2 to Hit and Bounty Hunter Talents if the Warbringer's Cleaver is wielded.
◆Spell: +1 sonic voice abilities (War Cryer).

†Reminder: A required weapon must be drawn to perform Abilities from any class's Tier, Path, or Branch; whether referring to the weapon Style, Type, Hand, Range or Grade.

Armor Thresholds
Grade: Light or Medium (Studded Leather, Light Chain). Bonus: +1 Hit and +1 Damage in leather or no armor; +2 and +2 to Hit and Bounty Hunter Talents if Studded Leather is worn.

+1 Hit and +2 to Bounty Hunter Talents if wearing Light or Medium (Light Chain).

Paths and Branches unlock various Armaments not available for Class Tier Abilities.

A Path or Branch's Weapon Requirements include every weapon already available to the Main Class, plus any new weapons that Path or Branch unlocks. A Path or Branch's Armor Threshold also rises without an Armament Penalty, typically half a Grade step above the Tier before it.

Armament Thresholds allow the given Grade and anything lighter. If Armor that is heavier than the Tyrant's Threshold is worn, Characters suffer the ensuing Penalties to the Armor's Score (see Armament Penalty, Basic Rules pg. 6).

Warlock (Not Playable in Starter Set)

Alignment Restrictions: Evil

Pact-bound wielders of forbidden power who draw their abilities from entities far beyond mortal comprehension, Warlocks channel dark contracts into magic that warps, drains, and corrupts everything it touches, a bargain that grows more consuming the deeper they pull from it, with their patron's fingerprints increasingly visible in everything they do and say.

‡ Abilities from their respective trees are summarized below. Ability Cards are released with Module and their expansions, supporting various Character Levels, and list the DIFS for any check an Ability requires. Refer pg. 6 for more on Ability Cards.

Note: Main Class baseline stats, Armament requirements and thresholds, and other Class features change depending on the Classes Tier, Path or Branch as noted in each respective Sub-Class.

Favored Races:
Drow +5, Human† +5, Orcus +5, Pinkling +5

†Human Playable with Starter Set.

Averse Races: Firbolg -5, Troll (Village) -5

Refer to Races for details on favored and averse paths and branches.

Passive Abilities:
These passive Abilities belong to the Main Class alone, granted once and active regardless of Tier, Path, or Branch; they are not re-granted, replaced, or duplicated at any Path or Branch.

Patron's Favor, lasts 6 hours (must be recast every 6 hours to stay active). No mana cost for Main Class Abilities.

Pact Calling, Once Per Day the Warlock calls upon their patron, dealing dark damage equal to twice their Willpower Score to one target, with the Warlock healing for half that amount.

Extra 1d6 + lvl dark damage on Critical Hits.
Once per encounter, Warlocks can Flourish their pact weapon that lowers their target's Resistance at a number equal to their Deceit Score.

Warlocks get +5 feet their base movement speed, once per encounter.

Warlocks get +4 plus their WILLPOWER Score on Knowledge checks involving forbidden lore.

Favorite Talent and Profession Trees
Talent Trees: Crypt Raider
Professions: Witchcrafter, Enchanter, Alchemist

No Cost to open talent tree. 5% rate increase on profession tiers. See Talent and Profession Bonuses: Races vs. Classes for how these bonuses work.

Features such as; Companion Pairing, buffs, and various Armaments and Accessories and their Modifiers and Enhancements modify base stats, refer to Basic Rules for more.

Armor Thresholds
Grade: Delicate or Light (Robes, Leather). Bonus: +1 spell potency in robes or leather; +2 and +2 to spell potency and Crypt Raider Talents if Robes is worn.

+1 to spell potency and +2 to Crypt Raider Talents if wearing Delicate or Light (Leather).

Paths and Branches unlock various Armaments not available for Class Tier Abilities.

A Path or Branch's Weapon Requirements include every weapon already available to the Main Class, plus any new weapons that Path or Branch unlocks. A Path or Branch's Armor Threshold also rises without an Armament Penalty, typically half a Grade step above the Tier before it.

Armament Thresholds allow the given Grade and anything lighter. If Armor that is heavier than the Warlock's Threshold is worn, Characters suffer the ensuing Penalties to the Armor's Score (see Armament Penalty, Basic Rules pg. 6).

Warrior (Not Playable in Starter Set)

Alignment: All

Comprehensive martial masters who have developed mastery across every armament type, from heavy armor and shield work through every blade discipline, spear, lance, and even command-level battlefield magic, Warriors are the most armor-flexible and weapon-diverse class in Essentia, capable of filling any martial role while outperforming dedicated specialists in their chosen lane at high levels.

‡ Abilities from their respective trees are summarized below. Ability Cards are released with Module and their expansions, supporting various Character Levels, and list the DIFS for any check an Ability requires. Refer pg. 6 for more on Ability Cards.

Battle Stance, lasts 6 hours (must be recast every 6 hours to stay active). No mana cost for Main Class Abilities.

Tactical Mastery, Once Per Day the Warrior adapts mid-combat, gaining a bonus to Hit and Damage equal to their Grit Score until the end of the encounter.

Extra 1d6 + lvl physical damage on Critical Hits.
Once per encounter, Warriors can Flourish their weapon that lowers their target's Defense at a number equal to their Strength Score.

Warriors get +5 feet their base movement speed, once per encounter.

Warriors get +4 plus their VIGOR Score on Endurance checks.

◆Shoot (e.g. longbow): 0.
◆Spell: +1 rune and storm (Warlord).

Armor Thresholds
Grade: Versatile (Heavy through Light). Bonus: +1 AS per Grade above Light when properly fitted; +2 and +2 to AS and Olympiad Talents if Half Chain is worn.

+1 AS and +2 to Olympiad Talents when wearing Medium or Light Grade otherwise.

Paths and Branches unlock various Armaments not available for Class Tier Abilities.

A Path or Branch's Weapon Requirements include every weapon already available to the Main Class, plus any new weapons that Path or Branch unlocks. A Path or Branch's Armor Threshold also rises without an Armament Penalty, typically half a Grade step above the Tier before it.

Armament Thresholds allow the given Grade and anything lighter. If Armor that is heavier than the Warrior's Threshold is worn, Characters suffer the ensuing Penalties to the Armor's Score (see Armament Penalty, Basic Rules pg. 6).

Witch (Playable in Starter Set)

Alignment Restrictions: Evil

Ancient practitioners of earth, moon, and brew magic who draw power from the natural world's oldest cycles, the pull of the moon, the chill of the north wind, and the bubbling of a well-crafted cauldron, Witches apply curses, potions, and elemental forces with an unpredictable mastery that feels less like a learned skill and more like a conversation with something that has always been listening.

‡ Abilities from their respective trees are summarized below. Ability Cards are released with Module and their expansions, supporting various Character Levels, and list the DIFS for any check an Ability requires. Refer pg. 6 for more on Ability Cards.

Note: Main Class baseline stats, Armament requirements and thresholds, and other Class features change depending on the Classes Tier, Path or Branch as noted in each respective Sub-Class.

Favored Races:
Drow +5, Elf (Sylvan) +5, Dwarf (Snow) +5, Goblorc +5, Ratkin +5

None Playable with Starter Set.

Averse Races: Hawkbear -5, Neanderthal (Glaciera) -5, Omnè -5

Refer to Races for details on favored and averse paths and branches.

Passive Abilities:
These passive Abilities belong to the Main Class alone, granted once and active regardless of Tier, Path, or Branch; they are not re-granted, replaced, or duplicated at any Path or Branch.

Hexweave, lasts 6 hours (must be recast every 6 hours to stay active). No mana cost for Main Class Abilities.

Coven's Curse, Once Per Day the Witch lays a hex upon one target, dealing nature damage equal to twice their Willpower Score and reducing their Resistance until the end of the encounter.

Extra 1d6 + lvl nature damage on Critical Hits.
Once per encounter, Witches can Flourish their focus that lowers their target's Resistance at a number equal to their Intuition Score.

Witches get +5 feet their base movement speed, once per encounter.

Witches get +4 plus their KNOWLEDGE Score on Knowledge checks involving curse and brew lore.

Favorite Talent and Profession Trees
Talent Trees: Mole
Professions: Witchcrafter, Apothecary, Alchemist

No Cost to open talent tree. 5% rate increase on profession tiers. See Talent and Profession Bonuses: Races vs. Classes for how these bonuses work.

Features such as; Companion Pairing, buffs, and various Armaments and Accessories and their Modifiers and Enhancements modify base stats, refer to Basic Rules for more.

Paths and Branches unlock various Armaments not available for Class Tier Abilities.

A Path or Branch's Weapon Requirements include every weapon already available to the Main Class, plus any new weapons that Path or Branch unlocks. A Path or Branch's Armor Threshold also rises without an Armament Penalty, typically half a Grade step above the Tier before it.

Armament Thresholds allow the given Grade and anything lighter. If Armor that is heavier than the Witch's Threshold is worn, Characters suffer the ensuing Penalties to the Armor's Score (see Armament Penalty, Basic Rules pg. 6).

▾ Collapse Armament

Witch Main Class Abilities
Each tree below runs Level 1 through 30, Tier (1-3), Path (4-20), Branch (21-30). Each Level offers 3 choices, learn only ONE. See Spell Cards individually for details, see card examples on this page. See Slots and Prerequisites, above.
Armaments reminder: Light Grade armor or lighter (robes, light leather, ritual garments); Weapon Style: Piercing (Norwitch, 1h, Melee); Weapon Type: Magic (Lunar, 2h; BrewMaster, 1h), path dependent. Weapon Type: Martial for Nature Drawn, Magic for Spell Drawn (Nature Drawn is curses and hexes struck through the blade, staff, or cauldron itself, not plain weapon technique). Wearing a heavier Grade brings a -5 Armament Penalty per Grade of difference.
Note: See each Classes respective Ability Card for full details; Ability Cards are released with Module and their expansions, supporting various Character Levels, and list the DIFS for any check an Ability requires. Refer pg. 6 for more on Ability Cards.

Fallen and Risen Classes

These rules are under heavy development. This is currently the full extent of the rule; more will be added over time.

Only classes bound to a Higher Power are capable of falling or rising. These are classes whose Abilities are granted by an external force, their alignment, oaths, and relationship with that power are the foundation of everything they can do.

Which Classes Can Fall or Rise

Lawful classes (Paladins, Clerics, Monks, Overseers, Avengers, etc.), bound to divine or lawful Higher Powers, may Fall.

Evil classes (Warlocks, Witches, Tyrants, Doom Knights, etc.), bound to evil or chaotic Higher Powers, may Rise.

Current Penalty

Falling or Rising characters whose alignment drifts all the way to Neutral can no longer perform or earn new Abilities from the class tree that is either lawful or evil, and they'll begin to take penalties and tests from their respective higher powers.

Stub: Full Fallen and Risen mechanics (Title weighting, class-specific tests, redemption, and transformation pacing) are not yet written. See the GM Codex for the matching GM-facing stub.
